scenario.name: I-85 Multi-Vehicle Pileup
scenario.description: A synthetic multi-vehicle crash on I-85 near the Downtown Connector at 16:00 sends a front-loaded wave of high-acuity ambulance patients, mostly to Grady, during the evening rush.
